_about: Third-party video skills the video-studio director routes to. `node pipeline/cli.mjs library` fetches them (pinned commits, skill folders only) into library/<pack>/. Read a skill's SKILL.md before using it; nothing here auto-loads as a Claude skill.

hyperframes.what: HeyGen's HTML/GSAP video framework: core, animation (24 text effects, 7 runtimes: GSAP, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, CSS, WAAPI, TypeGPU), creative direction, audio mixing, keyframes/camera, 400+ registry blocks (glitch, CRT, film grain, 3D titles, charts, maps, confetti), captions, music-to-video, slideshow, product-launch, faceless-explainer

remotion.license: Remotion License (free for individuals and small teams)
remotion.what: Remotion's official agent skills: best practices, create, captions, maps, multimedia, render, studio

manim.what: 3Blue1Brown-style maths/science animation: ManimCE + ManimGL best practices, a composer that plans an explainer

motion-graphics.what: 16 premium motion effects, animated charts, milestone reveal, 3D title sequence (Three.js), Apple-style launch film, Vox explainer, reel export, reference-to-motion

iart-tiktok.what: short-form retention editing, karaoke/word captions, lower thirds, countdowns

iart-explainer.what: explainer, whiteboard / draw-on, isometric 2.5D, diagram animation, Wrapped-style recap

iart-data.what: bar-chart races, CSV → video, animated infographics, presentation video

iart-ads.what: video ads + variants, launch/hype films, testimonial/quote videos

iart-type.what: kinetic typography: split-text, stagger, lyric videos, variable-font animation, beat-synced type

iart-youtube.what: YouTube intro/outro, logo stings, end screens, podcast audiograms

barty.what: measured sound-design pass (beat grid, cue list, SFX timing), motion B-roll for talking heads, three explainer energies, object separation (SAM 2)

toolkit.what: ffmpeg recipes, moviepy compositing, ElevenLabs voice/SFX/music, ACE-Step music generation, Playwright screen recording

anidoodle.what: code-drawn films, explainers, loops and drawing timelapses in 32 styles with composed scores; character consistency

opus-video.what: kinetic-typography motion reels (three.js) and hand-painted watercolour-and-ink cartoons (p5.brush)

lottie.what: text-to-Lottie: logo/type/icon animations, loaders, lower thirds, stat and chart animations as Lottie JSON

explainroo.what: explainers with a local Kokoro voice (no API key), Whisper timing and a canvas renderer

vox-director.what: Vox-style paper-collage explainers (needs an Atlas Cloud key for AI keyframes)

lemo-opuscar.what: 43+ code-made film styles: impasto, watercolor, ukiyo-e, ink wash, stained glass, silent film, cel anime 80s, pixel RPG, HD-2D, lowpoly, hologram HUD, satellite briefing, LiDAR, blueprint, teardown, risograph, silkscreen, art deco, swiss motion, spy titles, game show, shadow puppet, paper popup…
